title: RoSci: Exploring Robustness in Science VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.27750v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable significant progress in scientific tasks. However, these models are generally assumed to be presented with complete and accurate information, overlooking the challenges of erroneous/missing information in wild scenarios. To address this gap, we introduce the concept of Scientific Model Robustness, which defines a model's ability to detect anomalies, assess solvability, and perform self-calibration when faced with Information Error (inconsistencies) or Information Loss (insufficiency). Specifically, we present RoSci-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,220 samples using a seed-variant strategy across six degradation types. To address VLM fragility, we further propose RoSci-Agent, a framework that employs a Parse-Verify-Decide pipeline to vet premises before reasoning. translated_title: RoSci：探索科学视觉语言模型的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的最新进展显著推动了科学任务的发展。然而，这些模型通常被假定为接收完整且准确的信息，忽略了真实场景中信息错误/缺失所带来的挑战。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了“科学模型鲁棒性”的概念，该概念定义了模型在面对信息错误（不一致性）或信息缺失（不充分性）时检测异常、评估可解性以及进行自我校准的能力。具体而言，我们提出了RoSci-Bench，一个包含1,220个样本的诊断基准，采用种子-变体策略覆盖六种退化类型。为应对VLM的脆弱性，我们进一步提出了RoSci-Agent，一个采用“解析-验证-决策”（Parse-Verify-Decide）流程在推理前审查前提条件的框架。评估的VLM有时会回答前提无效或不完整的问题。RoSci-Agent取得了较高的……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出科学模型鲁棒性的概念，并构建了RoSci-Bench诊断基准和采用“解析-验证-决策”流程的RoSci-Agent框架，以增强视觉语言模型在科学任务中应对信息错误与信息缺失的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of Scientific Model Robustness, presents the RoSci-Bench diagnostic benchmark, and proposes RoSci-Agent with a Parse-Verify-Decide pipeline to enhance VLMs' resilience to erroneous and missing information in scientific tasks.
